# Kate Rogers (historian)

Kate Rogers is an American non‑profit executive who served as executive director of  Alamo Trust, Inc., the non‑profit organization responsible for the daily operations of the historic Alamo site in San Antonio, Texas.
Alamo Trust
Rogers became executive director of the Alamo Trust in March 2021.  She was promoted to president and CEO in the fall of 2025.  Less than two months later she was forced out after a public power struggle with Dan Patrick and Dawn Buckingham.  Rogers filed a lawsuit alleging that Patrick, Buckingham and members of the Alamo Trust board conspired and retaliated against her, violating her first amendment rights.
